notes.title: Palia Path Roadmap – Fall Fantasy 2025
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781408/9499faca8c709457189e66d701bd114683767db2.png[/img]

Welcome back, Palians, to the second edition of the Palia Path Roadmap! This is your seasonal snapshot of what’s coming next, what’s quietly brewing behind the scenes, and what exciting adventures lie a little further down the road.

This time around, we’ve got another update from our Director of Production, Maxwell Zierath, with a healthy helping of fresh features, barnyard beginnings, and a peak of what’s just over the horizon.

The leaves are turning, the barn doors are open, and there’s plenty to look forward to. Let’s take a stroll down The Path together!

[previewyoutube=VDF6nEjGDPM;full][/previewyoutube]

The Palia Path Roadmap video covers a lot of ground, so we’ve raked it all up for you here:

[h3]Fall Fantasy: Of Barns and Briars (Patch 0.195)[/h3]
The next patch 0.195, the Fall Fantasy: Of Barns and Briars update, introduces the Ranching skill (Animal Husbandry), new Home Lines, offers crisp new quests, and more. Take a peak of what’s fall-ing into place:
[list]
[*] Ranching Skill (Animal Husbandry)
[*] Home Lines: The Alchemist’s Cottage
[*] The Gardener Friendship Quests
[*] County Fair Bulletin Board Quests
[*] Introducing new daily quests, Tailor Tickets, and Hair and Makeup colors
[*] New Farmhouse Decor.
[*] ...and more!
[/list]
[h3]On the Horizon[/h3]
Check out what’s coming after Fall Fantasy: Of Barns and Briars. Some updates are just about ready for harvest, while others are still taking root, but all are actively in development!
[list]
[*] Enhancing Player Expression
[*] Palian Profiles
[*] Seasonal Celebrations, such as Spiritfest, Winterlights, and Luna New Year 2026
[/list]
[h3]Looking Ahead[/h3]
As summer winds down and the golden season of autumn rolls in, we’re so far from cooling off. The team is hard at work on new features and systems that will roll out over the next several updates, each one shaped by the community's feedback!

We also want to assure you that we’re continuing to develop and experiment with features we mentioned in our last Palia Path, including “Build Together” shared housing, additional accessibility improvements, and, of course, the early stages of our next Adventure Zone.

The team really appreciates seeing how you engage with the gameplay and design, and your feedback plays a key role in helping us improve the Palia Player experience over time.

[h3]Final Thoughts[/h3]
Whether you’re snuggling up with your Ormuu, or busting out the decor for Spiritfest, we’re excited to continue bringing the world of Palia to life.

We hope this second edition of Palia Path paints a clearer picture of what’s coming, and the seasonal surprises we’re preparing for the brisk months ahead.

There’s plenty of discovery waiting just over the horizon. Cozy season may be arriving, but things in Palia are just starting to heat up.

notes.title: Huge new Palia update may once again test Stardew Valley fans' loyalty
notes.content:
There's no shortage of life sims for fans of the genre to check out. Classics like Stardew Valley, The Sims 4, and Coral Island offer plenty to do, even for players who have spent hundreds of hours with them already. The more recent Palia has also garnered plenty of attention for its blend of fantasy aesthetics and Stardew -style farming and crafting. Now, it's expanding even further, with today's launch of the new Botanical Bliss update.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Coming Soon: The Elderwood Expansion Arrives on May 13
notes.content:
If you’ve been busy tending crops, fishing with friends, or perfecting your plush collection on your housing plot (no judgment, it’s a lifestyle), then you might’ve missed the news: the massive Elderwood Expansion is coming on May 13.

That’s right, our little fantasy life sim adventure is about to get a whole lot bigger… and maybe a lil’ spookier (but still cozy!), with the launch of the Elderwood Expansion, our most ambitious update so far.

[previewyoutube=3hQMyYoXIxs;full][/previewyoutube]

On May 13, the Elderwood Expansion opens the door [quite literally in Bahari Bay] to a mysterious new Adventure Zone: an ancient, overgrown forest teeming with magical Echo and secrets hidden beneath its shadowy canopy. New and veteran players can expect:

[list]
[*] A sprawling new Adventure Zone to explore, with a heightened sense of verticality and secret nooks to uncover.
[*] Aggressive (yet adorable) creatures such as the Ogapuu and elusive Shmole.
[*] New story quests starring familiar faces, including Nai’o and Subira.
[*] Hidden Artifacts that unlock powerful Relics, a new equipment system that buffs you and your party.
[*] Brand new fish, insects, and plushes to personalize your home.
[*] Hours of exploration, adventure, customization, and more for you and your friends.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781408/c9a1a6406dede0474a4a61cc207fc8906d8c9b6a.jpg[/img]

The Elderwood Expansion is fully free-to-play, and supports full cross-play and cross-progression. So whether you're relaxing solo in Kilima Village or teaming up with friends for an Elderwood Rockhopper hunt, your progress (and your plush collection) follows you everywhere.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781408/b1ac4e5f6e550a1667ea771e22db35c6ff367dcc.jpg[/img]

Ready to grow the coziest (and bounciest) squad in Palia? The new [url=https://palia.com/refer-a-friend]Elderwood Refer A Friend program[/url] lets you sprout your very own squad of adorable fungal friends – and it all starts by inviting your besties to play!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781408/ce2530d457bbcaf673066544c88f790e951e7bca.jpg[/img]

Each friend you refer unlocks a bigger, fully interactive Elderwood Fun Guy plush. 50 percent plush, 50 percent trampoline, 100 percent awesome — these little guys are more than just decor. Refer up to 5 friends to earn the Elderwood Fun Guy, Big Elderwood Fun Guy, Bigger Elderwood Fun Guy, Giant Elderwood Fun Guy, and the Giga Elderwood Fun Guy.

Did you miss out of the first set of Refer A Friend rewards? Fear not! New and veteran players can claim both the original set of rewards AND the Elderwood Fun Guy rewards for a limited time. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781408/a3a1a4c5993c69bea3a73ccff420fa3f7e828e93.jpg[/img]

Welcome Home... Welcome to Elderwood... coming May 13.

notes.title: Bug Out with an Insect-a-Palooza in Palia!
notes.content:
[b]Update June 20, 11am PST[/b]:  The Insect-a-Palooza Community Event has come to an end but Auni is super proud of the Bug Scouts banding together to catch over 25 million insect! 

To celebrate, login between now and [b]June 25, 7am PST[/b] to claim the Leafy Flutterfox Plush and 3 Mixed Hydrangea Flower Seedlings from your News Inbox! 

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

ICYMI: Insect plushies have buzzed into player’s homes following Palia’s Patch.180 update! And we don’t want these plushies to ‘fly’ under the radar. So we’re hosting an in-game Insect-a-Palooza where players will band together and work [as a colony, if you will] to catch [i][b]25 million insects[/b][/i] and earn some rewards that are truly the “bee’s knees!” The weeklong Insect-a-Palooza will [b]begin at 10:00 a.m. PST on Thursday, June 13 and ends at 10:00 a.m. PST on Thursday, June 20[/b].

[h1]Goal & Rewards[/h1]
So Auni really, REALLY wants you to help him out. Tish bet Auni that he couldn’t catch 
[b]25 million insects by June 20[/b]. While Auni never ‘fleas’ from an insect catching challenge, he’s willing to share the following sweet loot with all his fellow bug scouts if you help him reach this goal by June 20:

[list]
[*] A brand new plush especially for the Spring season – the Leafy Flutterfox Plush
[*] 3 Mixed Hydrangea Flower Seedlings 
[/list]
Everyone knows how Auni loves sending mail so if we reach this goal, he will be sending these rewards through the News Inbox for anyone that logs in between 11:00 a.m. PST on Thursday, June 20 until 7:00 a.m. PST on Tuesday, June 24.   

Ready to get buzzing? Collect your smoke bombs and honey lures, and team up with new and existing Palians for this reward-filled frenzy of insect wrangling! As they say, there is strength in numbers and some of the trickier bugs might need a good smoke bomb barrage before they are ready for capture! Here's how to join the party:
[list]
[*] Head over to the [url=https://discord.com/invite/playpalia]Official Palia Discord[/url] to meet up with other Bug Scouts. There's a dedicated channel just for #hunting-insects
[*] Spread the word in-game! Let everyone know you're setting up a Honey Lure party and watch the butterflies (and beetles!) flock to your location.
[/list]
Let’s get this Bug Brigade rolling! We'll see you out there, catching critters and building a more vibrant (and sometimes buggy, hehe) community! Hive Five!

notes.title: Dev Update #8 - Onwards to Patch 0.180!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781408/1e8ebd5ee2fd027c3eaff66393b97d2ee6a85548.png[/img]

Hi everyone,

This Dev Update is going to be all about 0.180, and we’re excited to talk about it because it’s going to be our biggest patch yet!

We have lots of great things in store to share, so let’s get into it.

[h1]Economy Updates
[/h1]

Major changes will be made to a lot of areas in the game, and we wanted to take the time to go over our approach and the changes in store.

[h2]Our Approach[/h2]

Something we value a lot for Palia is allowing players to play how you want to play. We also want Palians to feel that your time spent in the game is properly rewarded, no matter what activity you engage in. It’s something we think we missed the mark with initially, and have spent a lot of time evaluating changes that can be seen as positive improvements across the board. A lot of our changes will be focused on improving several areas when it comes to gold earned, and also gold spent.

Overall, we've tuned things so that most players should be earning more gold, paired with many items having recipe requirements and gold costs reduced.

In particular, what we noticed is that a lot of the gold earned in the game felt concentrated in certain areas, and not enough for several other skills. Gold earned from Mining will be tuned down, but to make up for it, the gold earned from other skills such as Foraging, Insect Catching, Hunting, and Fishing will be buffed. Thus, all skills should be on a more comparable and even playing field.

Other changes include granting more gold in areas such as quest progression and found treasure chests, as well as majorly reducing craft timers for Buildings.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781408/f71d5162ec4f724c1a0a5029e27928278f360c26.png[/img]

[b]So, TLDR: Lots of positive changes where you can expect to see more resources and more gold coming your way.[/b]

Listed below are some (but not all!) of the changes we intend to make:

[b]General Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Gold and Renown limits will be raised
[*] Drops for Flow-Infused Wood will be raised
[*] The cost to unlock the Copper Storage Recipe will be reduced significantly
[*] Treasure Chests found in the world will have better rewards to help out new players as they explore
[*] Over half of existing Workbench recipes have been revisited, with about 85% of those having reduced requirements
[*] The craft times for Gold and Silver Bars have been reduced from hours down to minutes
[*] Trees now have a chance to drop Amber, which can be sold as a high-value item
[*] The sell value for many Uncommon/Rare/Legendary items will increase for most skills
[/list]
[b]Housing Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Several building add-ons will take significantly less time to build — think within a Palian day, not real-life time.
[*] Players will receive building add-ons as rewards for reaching initial Furniture-Making Levels
[*] This applies retroactively as well through rewards in the Mail
[/list]
[b]Gardening Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] The cost to purchase Gardening Plots will be reduced
[*] Players will receive some seeds for reaching initial Gardening Levels
[*] The methods to obtain fertilizer, especially SpeedyGro, will be adjusted.
[/list]

Further details and specifics will be shared in the 0.180 Patch Notes, so please be on the lookout for that to get the full scope of changes in store.

We also acknowledge that, yes, it’s a lot of stuff we’re trying to do! Following the patch, we’ll be closely monitoring both player feedback and internal data to see if adjustments need to be made, as there’s always room for improvement.

That said, we look forward to seeing how players pick up on the many positive additions, as that’s the goal at the end of the day.

[h1]Updates to Our Premium Offerings[/h1]

We plan on doing some new things and adding different types of offerings to the Premium Store. Starting off with Pets and Tool Skins, you can see these two being added to the store in the next patch.

[h2]More Pets[/h2]
While the Palcats have taken the spotlight for a while now, expect more pets to be added in the future. This includes the upcoming FlutterFox pet!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781408/b7f05f1a4657a1e35eacabe53de8d7f83dd6c26c.png[/img]

There are five types you can choose from: Leafy, Spring, Summer, Autumn, and Winter.

[h2]Tool Skins[/h2]
Ever felt like adding a bit of glam to your tools? Introducing Tool Skins! We plan on adding three to start out: Spring Sakura, Empyreal, and Leafy Weave.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781408/af5276ca8f6727bdcbebab3e250b83c2e4138168.png[/img]

[h1]Fan-Favorite Features[/h1]

As mentioned in a previous dev update, several features will be making their way to our next patch!

This includes:
[list]
[*] [b]Building Blocks[/b] - Create unique structures with blocks, ramps, pillars, walls, and more!
[*] [b]Grand Harvest House[/b] - The regular Harvest House not cutting it for you? Unlock an upgraded version with this building!
[*] [b]Pavers [/b] - Creating winding roads and charming lanes with a variety of shapes and materials.
[/list]
Last but not least, it looks like something special is coming in hot… and by hot, we mean HOTPOT!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781408/0f30553e01b5fa69026a34c34f5a463e98c87a6c.png[/img]

Everyone’s favorite minigame has come back as a permanent addition over in the Underground area. Just don’t ask Zeki how he got them…
___

We’re still hard at work making sure this is a patch you don’t want to miss out on! 
Make sure to follow our socials for the latest details such as when the patch is happening. Be on the lookout!

notes.title: Dev Update #7 - Post 0.178 Thoughts
notes.content:
Hello, everyone! We hope that everyone has been enjoying Palia’s Steam Launch and the 0.178 update! But we also want to talk about some feedback that’s been brought to our attention.


[h1]Palia is Currently in Open Beta [/h1]
We want to clear the air: since our Open Beta launch back in August 2023, the game remains as a title still in Open Beta. Know that we’ll keep our players updated with as much information as possible as we approach what we consider to be our official launch. 

We know that there has been feedback regarding our messaging and status on various platforms, but the emphasis is that Palia is free-to-play and available for anyone to try. It is a continuous, ongoing effort, and we are committed to providing patch updates with new content, improvements, and bug fixes well into the future.

In fact, looking at our version, being on 0.178 means we’ve made over 178 updates to the game! Even from the start, and the days of Pre-Alpha, we made sure to include player feedback and have it shape Palia to be where it is today. And when it’s ready, we also plan to have the versioning update from “0.XXX” to “1.XXX” to better reflect Palia’s new status — but even that is not the end. We’ll keep having more patches after, and developing Palia alongside our players. That was one of the primary reasons why we wanted it to be a free-to-play, live-service game.

We invite everyone to be part of this journey.

[h1]What’s next?[/h1]
There’s some exciting content we’ve outlined in our March Dev Update, and some we’re not quite ready to share just yet as they need a bit more time to bake.

That said, we also want to share that additional quality-of-life and accessibility features on the horizon, such as:
[list]
[*] Brightness sliders
[*] Colorblind features
[*] UI and text adjustments
[/list]
To our players, your feedback and support of the game will keep shaping and improving Palia. This is something we extend to all players: new, old, and returning.

Thank you,
Singularity 6

notes.title: Palia is Coming to Steam on March 25
notes.content:
Hot off the Palian press! We’re throwing open the gates to Kilima Village for [GabeN] and all other players on Steam at 11 a.m. PT on Monday, March 25. If you enjoy swinging an [strike]crowbar [/strike]ax, farming [strike]creeps [/strike]crops, and [strike]b-hopping[/strike] jumping into an [strike]ongoing [/strike]evolving world story (yes, we’ve played one or two Valve games); then check out the steamy sizzle below:

So unless you’re still rocking a ball mouse, hop on-board the train (choo choo!) and wishlist Palia right now for free on Steam. In fact, the more Palians that Wishlist, the more opportunity for players to receive a snuggle-worthy free reward.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781408/56f2ffd6cc316bba0285681d3e376c5d699255bf.png[/img]

[h3]TL;DR[/h3]
[list]
[*] Palia launches on Steam on March 25, 2024.
[*] Participate in our Steam Wishlist Event to get a (hopefully) gigantic reward!
[*] Play wherever you want – there is no change to our existing PC gameplay experience.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781408/2f8284b7caea01f2b3a9f9366ec11f1724a4d89a.png[/img]

[h2]Wishlist Event Reward: Giga-Frogbert[/h2]
What’s more cozy than a Frogbert in-game plush? We’ll tell you: a MASSIVE Frogbert in-game plush. In fact, all players will unlock a Frogbert plush reward by logging in to Palia within 30 days of Palia’s launch on Steam. But let’s not stop there – the Frogbert plush will grow alongside our wishlists. For every 100,000 Wishlists, the Frogbert will increase in size until we hit 500,000 Wishlists, and all players will receive this kawaii, Kaiju-worthy Frogbert plush.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781408/ead44ca84363f55e34e4bec30c0b52c62989e435.png[/img]

And we want you to play with your friends across platforms! You can play with your friends cooperatively, or with a little friendly competition, because Palia on Steam supports cross-play and cross-progresion between all currently available platforms. So you Steam stalwarts can rest easy knowing that you can play with your friends on Nintendo Switch and more.

So make like a Vortigaunt and teleport to the Palia Steam page now to wishlist the game so you can be first to jump in when Palia launches globally on the platform at 11 a.m. PT on Monday, March 25. We look forward to welcoming you to [strike]Xen [/strike]Kilima Village very soon!
